Report on a comparison, as text

Source: R/report.R
diff_report.Rd

A bounded, readable account of a diff_table() result: which columns were compared, how the rows of the two tables align, and, for each measure that changed, how often it matches and its most frequent changes, each with an example key. Printing the report draws it; the numbers are in the returned list.

diff_report(d, x_name = "x", y_name = "y", top_k = 3L, sample_k = 5L)

Arguments

d

A result of diff_table().

x_name, y_name

The names the report gives the two tables.

top_k

The number of most frequent changes shown per measure; 0 hides them.

sample_k

The number of keys shown of the rows found in only one table; 0 hides them.

Value

A daffiz_report: a list holding the counts the report draws, with format() and print() methods. format() takes unicode, whether to draw with box-drawing characters (by default, when the session's encoding is UTF-8), and returns the lines of text.

Details

A row counts as changed when any of its measures changed. With duplicates = "aggregate" the units are keys rather than rows.

The layout is adapted from the summary of the Python package diffly.

Examples

x <- data.frame(id = c("a", "b", "c"), value = c(1, 2, 3))
y <- data.frame(id = c("a", "b", "d"), value = c(1, 2.5, 4))
diff_report(diff_table(x, y))
#> ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
